parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation or facility ban; X markers, bathroom use by identity, and courts enforcing anti-discrimination awards and transphobia criminalisation are working visitor-facing protections. However a 2026 review records significant violence and discrimination in practice, fatal dating-app/drink-spiking robberies targeting LGBTQIA+ people show elevated night/app risk, and a 2021 census in one major state found travestis/trans women housed in masculine units with recurring rights violations despite the 2020 national custody resolution requiring self-declared preference. That documented custody divergence, plus uneven subnational practice, keeps it in reduced rather than low risk.
